title: Normanton Gaol
scope: The standing Normanton Gaol compound at Haig Street: concrete cell ranges, open exercise yards with entrances, the later shower annex and the adjacent two-room timber trackers’ quarters.
limitations: The two roof envelopes come from QRA mapping. The exact exercise yard divisions, core and annex roof breakpoints, porch depth and entrance positions are reconstructed from written facts.
Roof elevations and paint are estimates. Interior fabric, furnishings and proposed park additions are outside scope.
Original terrain stays unchanged; door thresholds and foundation elevations are approximate.
No reference imagery was used. The archive candidate is excluded because its applicable rights are unresolved, and the other candidate does not depict this property.
